notes.title: This game is being revamped and reworked + new Content + Bug fixes!
notes.content:
Ok guys lemme update you on my plans for the future!

Since the quality of my games keeps improving , I am trying my best to deliver the best of me to all of you.

I got really excited with some recent events that made me take this decision.

Ok so let`s begin?

I finally finished working on one of my newest games Naxos.

I believe that game had potential so I made some nice visual improvements on it as well as updated the trailer as well as updated the game!

In Naxos now you will only be able to advance to the next stage if you defeat the previous enemy.

Also made sure I addes some achievments and I am quite happy for now!

I intend to remove from the store most of my old games that have bad quality. I am improving and I feel like having malfunctioning games such as KnC could damage my reputation as a game-dev

So What`s Next?

I was looking at my library and realized Norega still has lots of potential If I can manage to make it work right!

So I am taking the  decision to get back to working on this game and improving it!

I plan to take a look at all of the negative reviews study the game really hard and try to fix all current problems of the game.

I also feel like there could be a special place for extra free content and extra paid content.

Well thank you so much for supporting me in the darkest times!

This game formula shall be revamped with my new skills as well as I will see what I can do , I promisse changes!

Here I go again!

And thank you so much for choosing me!

Peace!

notes.title: Improvements!
notes.content:
Some game improvements:

1. The ability to mass produce all items at once has been added to all BUILDINGS.

2. Gold number tiers are now even higher. 1M < 1B < 1T <1Q < 1R <1S...

The jeweler and the lab should now have better number adjustments for Herbs and Gems.

IDLE - MODE will support larger numbers now! 

I hope you like these changes!

Do you want to suggest something? Please be open about it so you and I can engineer the best IDLE experience ever! As long as I dont have to change the whole game...

As well as added an increasing cost to hers and jewels.... That should help in performance
and Legibility...

notes.content:
Couldnt do everything I wanted but wanted to patch things up before going for a broader patch that will require more time....

notes.title: Changes from "Suggestions"
notes.content:
Idle mode will now display only 2 decimal houses.

Loot will now increase every stage... (Stage 15 = 15* loot)

The latest used Save slot will now have a Golden Face.

Fixed some bugs....

notes.title: New Changes!
notes.content:
You will now have concatenated numbers like 1m = 1million 1b = 1billion and so on....

I have also changed the formula when crafting to make sure it runs much much faster.

I hope you like these changes! 

=)

notes.title: STAGE CAP*
notes.content:
Stage is now capped at 1 if you want to advance to stage 2 you must defeat the boss at stage 1,
and if you want to advance to stage 3 you must defeat the boss at stage 2.

You must defeat them in ACTIVE MODE at least once!
